description: This file contains core classes and functions for the Kivy framework's event loop and application management, including exception handling, event dispatching, and application startup/shutdown procedures.

classes.name: ExceptionHandler
classes.description: Base class for handling exceptions within the Kivy event loop, allowing subclassing for custom exception handling.

classes.name: ExceptionManagerBase
classes.description: Manages a stack of exception handlers and defines policies for exception handling.

classes.name: EventLoopBase
classes.description: Main event loop class managing input, event dispatching, and application lifecycle.

methods.name: handle_exception
methods.description: Method in ExceptionHandler to process exceptions; defaults to re-raising the exception.

methods.name: add_handler
methods.description: Adds an exception handler to the stack.

methods.name: remove_handler
methods.description: Removes an exception handler from the stack.

methods.name: handle_exception
methods.description: Handles exceptions in the main event loop according to the current policy.

methods.name: ensure_window
methods.description: Ensures that a window exists, exits if not.

methods.name: set_window
methods.description: Sets the window used by the event loop.

methods.name: add_input_provider
methods.description: Adds an input provider for touch events.

methods.name: remove_input_provider
methods.description: Removes an input provider.

methods.name: add_event_listener
methods.description: Adds a listener for touch events.

methods.name: remove_event_listener
methods.description: Removes a touch event listener.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the event loop and input providers.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Stops the event loop and input providers.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops input providers and dispatches stop callbacks.

methods.name: add_postproc_module
methods.description: Adds a post-processing module for input events.

methods.name: remove_postproc_module
methods.description: Removes a post-processing module.

methods.name: remove_android_splash
methods.description: Removes Android presplash if applicable.

methods.name: post_dispatch_input
methods.description: Dispatches an input event to listeners and grabbed widgets.

methods.name: _dispatch_input
methods.description: Internal method to queue input events.

methods.name: dispatch_input
methods.description: Reads input events from providers, processes, and dispatches them.

methods.name: mainloop
methods.description: Runs the main event loop until quit.

methods.name: async_mainloop
methods.description: Asynchronous version of the main event loop.

methods.name: idle
methods.description: Per-frame update: clock tick, input dispatch, rendering.

methods.name: async_idle
methods.description: Async version of idle, used within async event loops.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs the event loop until quit.

methods.name: exit
methods.description: Closes the event loop and window.

methods.name: on_stop
methods.description: Event handler called after stopping input providers.

methods.name: on_pause
methods.description: Event handler for pausing the event loop.

methods.name: on_start
methods.description: Event handler for starting the event loop.

methods.name: _runTouchApp_prepare
methods.description: Prepares and starts the application, setting up input, window, and event loop.

methods.name: runTouchApp
methods.description: Starts the Kivy application with a widget, managing the event loop.

methods.name: async_runTouchApp
methods.description: Async version of runTouchApp, compatible with asyncio event loops.

methods.name: stopTouchApp
methods.description: Stops the current Kivy application and event loop.
